title: Generalizing Test-time Compute-optimal Scaling as an Optimizable Graph
abstract: arXiv:2511.00086v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Test-Time Scaling (TTS) improves large language models (LLMs) by allocating additional computation during inference, typically through parallel, sequential, or hybrid scaling. However, prior studies often assume fixed collaboration architectures (e.g., topologies) and single-model usage, overlooking that optimal architectures and model combinations can vary across tasks. Therefore, we study the novel problem of searching for compute-optimal model combinations and architectures in TTS under a fixed budget. We formalize it as a multi-LLM collaboration graph, where nodes encode roles and LLM model assignments, and edges capture information flow. This problem is challenging because (i) the combinatorial search space is prohibitively large, and (ii) task-specific requirements demand tailored designs. translated_title: 将测试时计算最优扩展泛化为可优化的图
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展通过在推理过程中分配额外的计算来提升大型语言模型（LLM）的性能，通常采用并行、串行或混合扩展方式。然而，先前的研究往往假设固定的协作架构（例如拓扑结构）以及单一模型的使用，忽略了最优架构和模型组合可能因任务不同而变化。因此，我们研究了一个新问题：在固定预算下搜索测试时扩展中计算最优的模型组合与架构。我们将其形式化为一个多LLM协作图，其中节点编码角色和LLM模型分配，边则捕捉信息流。这个问题具有挑战性，原因在于： 组合搜索空间极其庞大， 任务特定需求需要定制化的设计。为解决这些问题，我们将该问题重新表述为概率图优化，并通过初步实验得出了三条经验性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将测试时扩展中在固定预算下搜索计算最优模型组合与架构的新问题形式化为多LLM协作图，并将其重新表述为概率图优化问题，以应对庞大的组合搜索空间和任务定制化需求。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the novel problem of searching for compute-optimal model combinations and architectures in test-time scaling under a fixed budget as a multi-LLM collaboration graph, and reformulates it as probabilistic graph optimization to address the prohibitive combinatorial search space and task-specific design requirements.
